note: Both arms read the repositories at one path -- the MCP arm's git server reads the image's own /data/repos in the run's container, and each mirage /data/repos mount is a copy of one taken out of the same image; no tool this task enables reads the rest of /data. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing. MongoDB is the database this run restores from Atlas's dump, the same one both arms read.

cases.name: aggregate
cases.why: both arms group the same August 2023 stock by genre

mirage.pipe: jq -s -r 'map(select(."Inventory Date"."$date" | startswith("2023-08-"))) | group_by(."Game Genre")[] | [.[0]."Game Genre", (map(."Current Stock") | add), length] | @tsv' | sort
